content.text:
I fixed the file tree's right-click menu and made naming inline. A test drives the real menu and fails on the old behaviour. All 222 tests pass (1 ignored), both builds have no warnings, and the piton checks and build pass. I haven't tried it in the running app.

**Why the menu was glitchy.** Every row had its own context menu, and so did the empty space around the rows. One right-click on a row opened two menus stacked on top of each other; the new test confirmed this before I changed anything. Picking an item closed one menu and left the other open. That leftover menu grabs focus every frame, so the name input lost focus and the naming was cancelled almost as soon as it started. gpui-kit's menu also leaks a little memory each time one opens, which the test harness flagged.

**The fix** (all in `src/project_tree.rs`):
- **One menu:** the tree owns a single menu. A right-click on a row opens it for that row and stops there, so the background's menu never opens too. Opening it again replaces the one already open. There's no leak.
